item.lacuna.arrival_shard.lore: The right half. It wants to stay.
item.lacuna.arrival_shard.use: Use: throw; it anchors where it lands.
item.lacuna.departure_shard.lore: The left half. It wants to go back.
item.lacuna.departure_shard.use: Use: travel to the linked anchor (same dimension).
item.lacuna.divine_magnifying_glass.lore: Sunlight remembers where it was told to go.
item.lacuna.divine_magnifying_glass.use: Hold use: focus a burning beam of light.
item.lacuna.eclipser.lore: Where it cuts, the light forgets to return.
item.lacuna.fractured_pearl.lore: Two halves that never stopped looking for each other.
item.lacuna.fractured_pearl.use: Use: split into an Arrival and a Departure shard.
item.lacuna.suns_fury.lore: A noon that was never allowed to end.
item.lacuna.suns_fury.use: Use: throw. Single use. Burns everything near the impact.
item.lacuna.totem_of_banishing.lore: A stone hand that remembers a land no one else does.
item.lacuna.totem_of_banishing.use: Use: enter or leave the Forgotten Land. Strike: banish the target.
